records.title: How does RAII release a lock?
records.topic: How does RAII release a lock?

rounds.reply: The lock is held by an object; when the object goes out of scope its destructor releases the lock.

rounds.request: Write that up as a note.
rounds.reply:
Done: [[Notes/Lock guards|Lock guards]] explains it with an example.

```cpp
std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(m);
```
